autoContext: Validates context filtering (build_ctx). Verifies that includedData restricts which keys reach handlers, dot-notation extracts nested values, engine globals (__config__, __schema__) are only delivered when explicitly listed in includedData, and loop results are stored as full dicts with dot-extractable keys.

prepare._comment: Load fixture with nested dict into step_output under key 'nested'.

test_filter._comment: Both 'data' and '__config__' are in includedData — they must substitute. 'secret' is NOT listed — it must stay blocked. shell _SafeMap leaves unknown placeholders as literal '{key}' strings.

test_passthrough._comment: __config__ is listed in includedData so it is substituted. secret is not listed so it stays blocked.

test_dot_path._comment: Dot-notation 'leaf=nested.leaf' extracts only nested['leaf'] into ctx as 'leaf'. The sibling key and the full nested dict are not in ctx, so {sibling} and {nested} stay as literal placeholders.

test_loop_dot._comment: Loop result stored as full dict under 'loop_data'. continueKey stops after 1 iteration.
Dot-notation extracts loop_data.iteration_output as 'iter_out'. The full loop_data dict is not in ctx. Python checks the scalar value was correctly delivered via stdin.
test_loop_dot.source: import sys; v = sys.stdin.read().strip(); out = 'ok' if 'iteration-' in v else 'FAIL:' + repr(v); print(out)
